name: MV Imperial Eagle
level: Experienced (Advanced Open Water and deep experience)
description: Former Malta–Gozo ferry, about 45 m long, scuttled in 1999 in a protected marine area some 500 m off Qawra Point. Upright on sand at 42 m, its deck at 32 m; rooms and corridors can be swum through, though most wooden parts have rotted away. Right next to the Christ statue and Qawra Reef.
note: Researched October 2026; added because it was missing from OpenStreetMap's dive sites.
